availableCommands.name: create-skill
availableCommands.description: Guide for creating a new Bob skill (SKILL.md) — covers the frontmatter schema, name rules, file location, and gotchas. Use when the user wants to author, create, or scaffold a skill.

availableCommands.name: create-mode
availableCommands.description: Guide for creating a new custom Bob mode (custom_modes.yaml) — covers the schema, permission groups, roleDefinition, and file location. Use when the user wants to author, create, or scaffold a mode or persona.

availableCommands.name: configure-hooks
availableCommands.description: Add, update, remove, or troubleshoot Bob lifecycle hooks. Use when the user wants to configure automatic commands or HTTPS requests for session, prompt, tool, or stop events.

availableCommands.name: configure-mcp
availableCommands.description: Add a new MCP server or diagnose an existing one — covers local vs remote transport, system dependency checks (node, docker, podman, python, uv), config schema validation, secrets handling, and scope. Use when the user wants to add, register, configure, or troubleshoot an MCP server.

availableCommands.name: build-mcp-server
availableCommands.description: Guide for building a custom MCP server from scratch — covers project scaffolding, the v2 registerTool/registerResource/registerPrompt API, API key and OAuth authentication patterns, building and registering the server. Use when the user wants to create, build, or write a custom MCP server.

availableCommands.name: office-insights
availableCommands.description: Use when the user wants to read, edit, create, or inspect a .docx, .xlsx, or .pptx file using the office_read and office_edit tools.
